storyCards.headline: Lovin On Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Jack Harlow's "Lovin On Me" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 38 weeks on the chart.

Lovin On Me was released in 2023.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
